content.short: A Cardano NFT project where digital art and history come together
content.description:
PyramidArt is a project that creates highly detailed digital art of historical structures and feats of nature known all around the globe, and combining that with interesting facts about these monuments. The goal is twofold, firstly to rejoice the PyramidArt community with beautiful works of art that hopefully everybody would really enjoy looking at and to have in their wallet, attempting to make these NFT’s real Cardano collectors’ items.

Secondly, the aim is to spread knowledge and awareness on these historical monuments, hoping the community might learn some interesting facts about some of the most beautiful sights our world has to offer. And perhaps, to encourage some people to go and visit some of these stunning places. Therefore, a lot of effort leading up to the mint is put in spreading these historical insights, whereafter these historical facts will be recorded on the Cardano blockchain forever, within the metadata of each NFT.

In line with this vision these collections of digital art will be released at very low minting prices, as the primary goal is not to make money, and therefore with a zero promise that these NFT’s will ever gain in value. I really enjoy making all kinds of art, and just want to share with the world what I find beautiful to create, as well as spreading some knowledge on what I find interesting, history. And if I spark the interest of even one person to actually go and visit some of these places, that would be beneficial for the local economies too.
